notes.title: 1.1 Valentine's update!
notes.content:
This version adds two new characters, Multifarious Mammal and Rock Enthusiast, who can be battled for a new Princess Remedy booster. They also come with a small optional sidequest, which is fully compatible with your existing savefile and can be experienced at any point in the main story. But make your choices carefully, as there is no going back on your word in this amorous sidequest!

There are also some other hacks thrown in that only apply when you start a new game, for the truly cardcore. Please see below for details.

Full changelist:
- Multifarious Mammal booster battle in Harbor Street.
- Rock Enthusiast booster battle in Big Chest Casino.
- New Princess Remedy booster with ten new cards, which can also be obtained through the Recycle Shop at random.
- Small Boss rematch deck tweaks.
- Renarama card buffed slightly (Cannot be disabled).
- Entering HardPlaya as your name begins the terribly unfair Hard Mode, where the player begins each match with 4 HP and the opponent with 8 HP. There is no reward for beating this mode and no other changes! Not recommended for new players!
- Entering ReallyPlaya as your name begins the farcical Impossible Mode, where the player begins each match with 1 HP and the opponent with 10 HP.  There is no reward for beating this mode and no other changes! Not recommended for anyone!

notes.title: Patch 1.01: Hotfixes!
notes.content:
Here's some new hotfixes made for the game. 

NOTE: If you were a victim of any of the major bugs (that removed cards from your collection) you can somewhat remedy this by going into the Options menu (accessed from the profile screen) and choose "Reset Cards". This will however reset ALL your cards back to the base deck + all the legendaries you've unlocked so far. Progress, stats and coins are unchanged. But with just a little bit of grinding you'll have everything you need for a good deck again.

We apologize for any inconvenience that any of these bugs may have caused you and hope that you will have a smooth experience from here on out.

Change log:
-----------------
Fixed bug that would remove cards left in the recycle shop when leaving.
Fixed bug that would remove your deck and legendaries when recycling.
Fixed bug that would remove cards left in the alchemy card slots when leaving.
Removed some left over debug key bindings.
Changed recycle value required for a new booster to 20 down from 25.
Fixed bug that would remove legendaries you've unlocked when resetting your card collection.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Card City Nights
notes.content:
Card City Nights is Now Available on Steam and is 50% off to celebrate!

Card City Nights is an adventure through a city filled with card-nuts and lunatics. Battle for the 8 legendary cards to enter the biggest competition this city has seen yet.


CCN is not a traditional card-trading game. It's an adventure game with lots of funny characters and locations to find. There are no IAP's in this game! You collect booster packs by simply playing the adventure from start to finish.
